# Welcome to the world of Oathlord...
Oathlord is a dark fantasy SS14 fork, set in a medieval-like setting.
## What, still here? Hand it over, that thing...
...your attention.
We are actively developing features, and as such, many of them will have breaking changes before release.
Our aim is to prototype first, and then refine, instead of wasting time on early-polishing. In all cases, the guidebook is used to actively document our progress on core systems.
You can check out the pages that are available on the sidebar.
